description: Google Tag Manager web tag template that loads the ByAds Pixel to measure page views, conversions and ad-click attribution.
rules: Install the template from the Google Tag Manager Community Template Gallery by searching for "ByAds Pixel", or import template.tpl from this repository. It only works in web containers.
The Client ID field is required. It identifies the advertiser in ByAds; ask the ByAds account manager for it.
Create one ByAds Pixel tag per event. The pixel script loads once per page and every later tag reuses it.
The template does not wait for consent on its own. Require consent in the tag's Advanced Settings > Consent Settings.
If the site has a Content Security Policy, allow https://pixel.byads.co in script-src, connect-src and img-src.
Do not rename template parameters or the __advBeacon, __advBeaconInbox and __advBeaconReady globals: installed tags and the pixel script depend on them.
